**Analyst / Senior Analyst, Transfer Pricing,** *Deloitte LLP, Vancouver, BC*   
*Mar 2021 - Aug 2024*  

- Assisted multinational companies develop, defend and document pricing strategies for intercompany transactions involving goods, services, intellectual property, and financing.

- Acted as engagement manager on multiple client projects; translated complex transfer pricing issues into clear project scopes, maintained proactive client communication to ensure smooth delivery, and presented findings effectively to non-technical stakeholders. 

- Led the development of a management fee model for a public mining company to allocate charges upward of C\$5 million to foreign subsidiaries. Earned client commendation for clearly communicating model results to key stakeholders and delivering project on a tight audit deadline.

- Conducted cost analysis for a global apparel company by transforming unstructured data to evaluate Canadian manufacturing margins against market benchmarks; Communicated results to key stakeholders to support annual transfer pricing documentation.

- Developed financial and credit rating models using client financial and operational data to assess corporate creditworthiness and support pricing of intercompany financing arrangements. 

- Identified a new business opportunity and supported the Lead Partner in securing an advisory engagement with a public biotech company in Q2 2023.
